question: Who alone removes illusion and protects, according to the address to the lady of the world?
premises: Removal of illusion is attributed to a single agent.
Protection is attributed to that same agent.
No other is affirmed to perform these functions.
inference: The goddess alone is the remover of illusion and the protector, with no other.
plain_english: O Lady of the world, she is the remover of illusion and the protector; there is indeed no other.
